tldr: Venus in Sagittarius: love needs freedom, honesty, and shared exploration.
body: With Venus in Sagittarius, attraction grows through adventure, laughter, truth, and a wider horizon. You value relationships that expand rather than confine.
gift: Optimism, candor, generosity, and love of shared discovery.
challenge: Restlessness, bluntness, and leaving when accountability feels like limitation.
note: Authored from approved project planet-through-sign material.
